title: Pay the unmanned aircraft levy
what: An unmanned aircraft levy is imposed; the regulations set it at $40 for a remotely piloted aircraft over 500 grams and nil for lighter ones.

sources.title: Civil Aviation (Unmanned Aircraft Levy) Act 2020
sources.quote: 5 Imposition of levy Unmanned aircraft levy is imposed.

sources.title: Civil Aviation (Unmanned Aircraft Levy) Regulations 2021
sources.quote: 5 Amount of unmanned aircraft levy For the purposes of subsection 6(1) of the Act, the amount prescribed is: (a) for levy payable in relation to an RPA that weighs more than 500 grams—$40; and (b) for levy payable in relation to an RPA that weighs 500 gram or less—nil.
